aggregate.method: Pooled median of checked_total_s; equal observation counts per case, no significance or generalization claim

protocol.cold: fresh model after imports/probing; process startup excluded
protocol.warm: retained wrapper, objective/RHS updates; native reuse depends on recorded workflow policy
protocol.timing: workflow_s includes construction/update and solve API, including wrapper-specific checks; checked_total_s adds common checker
protocol.phase_caveat: canonicalization/native construction can occur inside solve_api_s; phases are not identical across APIs
protocol.formulation: all adapters use native column bounds; CVXPY discovery checks representative canonical A/c/b/bounds exactly and records its interface; no extra canonicalization is timed
protocol.order: cyclic positions then reversed cycles; each case and mode counterbalanced separately
protocol.completion_policy: requested_matrix_complete covers measured rows only; warmup outcomes are separately counted and retained
protocol.reference: production: -y'Ax >= -y'b for y>=0; network: c=A'y+r, r>=0 and r'x*=0; planted x* feasible
protocol.reference_limit: analytic witnesses evaluated in floating point; shared HiGHS is not an independent backend cross-check
protocol.family_limit: planted optima retain support/tight rows across updates; active-set changes and difficult degeneracy are not qualified
protocol.scaling: power16 is coefficient row-scale spread, not a measured matrix condition number
scope_exclusions: SolverPilot automatic routing and production contracts
protocol.budget: global soft stop checked before each operation; native time limit excludes construction/checking
protocol.statistics: timing summaries include accepted measured rows only; failed/unavailable counts remain explicit; p95 descriptive without significance claims

canonicalization_probes.scope: small discovery probe; not a native matrix snapshot of every timed solve

clean_installations.scope: same candidate wheel in two fresh local environments and separate Python processes

raw_artifact_scope: Full locally retained JSON; digests bind these summaries. Re-running produces fresh timings, not byte-identical evidence.
